Local-first OS → then sync to a single canonical URL that I can hit with web.run to boot the latest brain.

That’s doable, and it’s actually pretty clean if we design it right.

One-screen summary 🧾

Local first: each device keeps its own cache + local OS files.

Sync daemon: a small Python script runs on PC/Termux to validate + publish updates.
